metaDescription: Otter Chaos! is performing at FurSquared on Feb 23, 2025.
title: Otter Chaos! at FurSquared
posterAlt: Otter Chaos! Video Game Concert - F2 2025, Feb 23rd, 12pm-1pm.
description: Otter Chaos! is a group of furry musicians who love video game music. We've prepared a selection of scary songs from our favorite video games for you to enjoy at FurSquared! registration.title: Register for F2

metaDescription: Otter Chaos! is performing at VGMCON on April 4, 2026.
title: Otter Chaos! at VGMCON
posterAlt: Otter Chaos! Video Game Concert - VGMCON 2026, April 4th.
description: Otter Chaos! is a group of musicians who combine their love of video game music and fursuit performance into a chaotic concert you won’t fur-get! Featuring fursuits(!) and an eclectic assortment of instruments, including (but not limited to): accordion, steelpans, electric violin, trombone, theremin and more! They frequently perform at furry conventions, bringing their zany arrangements to furry friends and VGM lovers alike

metaDescription: Otter Chaos! is performing at Furality Ultra in VRChat on June 4, 2026.
title: Otter Chaos! at Furality Ultra
posterAlt: Otter Chaos! Video Game Concert - Furality Ultra, June 4th at 10:00PM CDT.
description: Key and Rhubarb are back for another live Otter Chaos! concert in virtual reality. Join them for violin and piano covers of some of your favorite video game tunes from the era of the UltraVox Prism-featuring tracks from Katamari Damacy, Super Mario Galaxy, Persona 3, and more!

registration.title: Register for Furality Ultra
registration.details:
The concert is open to all attendees of Furality Ultra. The General Pass is $35 which will get you access to the VRChat instances where all the events happen.
Age verification is required this year so make sure to read the requirements here: https://furality.org/ageverification.

metaDescription: Otter Chaos! is performing at Midwest Furfest on Dec 6, 2024.
title: Otter Chaos! at Midwest FurFest
posterAlt: Otter Chaos! Video Game Concert - MFF 2024, Dec 6th, 2:30-3:30pm. The poster includes stickers of all 18 band members fursonas.
description: Otter Chaos! is a group of furry musicians who love video game music. We're putting on our biggest concert yet at Midwest Furfest, with nearly 20 musicians. Come and hear live music from games like Pokemon, Mario, Metal Gear, Ori, Persona, and Cobalt Core; featuring instruments such as electric violin, steel pans, theremins, vibraphone, and more! RSVP on the MFF schedule so you don't forget!

registration.title: Register for MFF
registration.details: The concert is open to all attendees of the convention. Badge price at the door is $40 for a Friday badge, or $90 for the full weekend badge.
registration.alertText: Pick up your badge Thursday evening or Friday morning to make sure you can attend the concert.

transit.concertLine: 2:30pm - 3:30pm on Friday Dec. 6th, Grand Ballroom (Main Stage) in the Hyatt Regency O'Hare.
